artboards.title: Option A · The measured arc — recommended

annotations.text:
A GREEN SQUARE SAYS NOTHING. THIS SHOULD SAY WHAT THE APP DOES.

Every tracker could use a leaf or a scale. The one thing that makes TrackIt different is that it distinguishes what has been measured from what has not — so the mark carries that, and nothing else.

Option A is built and running in the app right now; the three beside it are genuine alternatives on different axes (data-diagram, typographic, organic), each with its tradeoff stated. Say which you want and I will switch it.
THE ALTERNATIVES — different axes, not three shades of the same idea. Each card states the case against itself as well as for it.
